stories.headline: FDIC Stablecoin Rulemaking Shows Differences on Fees and Deposits
stories.body: Regulating new technology has never been as easy as it is necessary. And U.S. federal banking agencies gave stablecoin regulation their strongest shot during the recent rulemaking period for the federal GENIUS Act’s implementation. stories.headline: California financier arrested for $100 million bank fraud
stories.body: Federal prosecutors arrested and charged Mahender Makhijani, 44, with orchestrating a $100 million bank fraud against Western Alliance Bancorp.

stories.headline: SpaceX to close above $2 trillion market cap on its debut, prediction market traders say
stories.body: Traders on Polymarket think it's likely SpaceX will join a group of just six companies with a market value beyond $2 trillion.
